blurb: Guests rent kayaks, stand up paddleboards, or surfskis and can join guided tours or lessons. Rentals include necessary safety gear and require a mandatory introductory paddling session for first-timers. The business operates mainly from March through October and offers various skill-level lessons and winter paddling clubs.
